settings.label: Discount note
settings.info: Only fill this in when an automatic discount for these products exists under Discounts, for example "10% off the set". Shoppers see it with "Discount applied at checkout". The total always shows the real prices.

settings.label: Button label
settings.info: Leave blank for "Add selected to cart".

settings.content: The total is the sum of the real prices of the ticked items. All items are added in one step.
